blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said on Wednesday that he is recruiting Gabriel Go of the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) to join the Department of Transportation (DOTr). He announced it more than a week after returning to the DOTr as its secretary. Go heads the MMDA’s Special Operations Group-Task Force for Road Clearing, an agency that operates under the Office of the President. “I am recruiting him into the DOTr. I hope he can join us in the DOTr,” Dizon told reporters in an interview as he inspected the Antipolo station of Light Rail Transit 2. READ: MMDA […]...
